day_shape: 64 items: IRGC claims missile-drone strikes on Patriot radars at two Bahrain bases and prior F-16 damage (CENTCOM denies), UKMTO reports two tankers hit off Khasab, CENTCOM marks day 130 of Iran blockade, IDF strikes Gaza vehicle it says carried Islamic Jihad operatives, Iraqi forces move on Kataib Hezbollah stronghold Jurf al-Nasr.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and tanker incidents
threads.summary: UKMTO reported two tankers struck by unidentified projectiles off Oman's Khasab within an hour of each other leaving the Strait of Hormuz, while CENTCOM marked 130 consecutive days of its blockade against Iran. Iran International reported Tehran signalling it would treat the siege as an act of war; IRIB and Defa Press cited an ABC report of US escort numbers falling from 150 to 8 ships and an army spokesperson asserting Iranian control of the strait.

threads.label: IRGC strike claims and US denials
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press said IRGC Aerospace Force launched a combined missile-drone operation codenamed "Ya Umm al-Baneen" against two Patriot radars at al-Rifa and Awali bases in Bahrain and claimed damage to a US F-16; Defa Press also reported a drone shot down over the northern Gulf near Bushehr. CENTCOM called the F-16 claim false, saying all US fighter jets in the region were safe and accounted for.

threads.label: Gaza aid-vehicle strike dispute
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Tel al-Hawa in Gaza City whom it said were falsely presented as aid workers; World Central Kitchen denied ties to the vehicle and a Reuters witness described packaged foodstuffs and WCK papers inside. Hamas, cited by Defa Press, called the strike a continuation of a "hunger war" and said three charity-kitchen staff were killed.

threads.label: Iraq moves on Kataib Hezbollah area
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Iraqi federal forces taking over checkpoints previously held by Kataib Hezbollah as Baghdad moves to reclaim a militia stronghold south of the capital. Defa Press cited Iraqi armed forces spokesperson Sabah al-Numan on a new plan to extend security control across Jurf al-Nasr and begin reconstruction.

threads.label: Yemen-Saudi exchanges and Riyadh explosions
threads.summary: IRIB cited Arabic sources reporting explosions in Riyadh from Yemeni drone attacks and sirens in al-Sulayyil, alongside eight Saudi airstrikes on Mokha in Taiz. Defa Press cited Yemen's military media announcing drone strikes on Saudi reinforcements across multiple fronts.

threads.label: Iran economy, diplomacy and winter shortages
threads.summary: Iran International reported Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent calling Iran's rulers "wounded cornered animals" while President Pezeshkian warned business leaders of a silent economic war harder than the missile war; IRIB and Defa Press quoted Pezeshkian on planning for winter energy shortfalls. Defa Press cited Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi telling al-Mayadeen that Tehran would treat the blockade as a wartime act and urging Washington toward diplomacy.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and press controls
threads.summary: Iran International reported a 22-year-old Sharif University student who had condemned a girl's killing died by suicide, a witness account of January's Rasht protest crackdown, a parliamentary bill tying online accounts to real identities, and moves to license journalists and pursue exiles via Interpol. It also reported Iran-linked hackers posed as a US think-tank expert to target Australian broadcaster Erin Molan.

events.summary: 🎥 آسیب به جنگنده F۱۶ آمریکایی و لغو ماموریت آن با شلیک سامانه های بومی نیروی پدافند هوایی ارتش 🔸 روابط عمومی ارتش اعلام کرد: شامگاه جمعه، سامانه‌های بومی نیروی پدافند هوایی ارتش مستقر در جنوب کشور، تحت کنترل شبکه یکپارچه پدافند هوایی کشور، موفق به کشف و شناسایی یک فروند جنگنده F۱۶ آمریکایی بر فراز خلیج فارس شدند. 🔸 در جریان این عملیات، سامانه‌های پدافندی پس از رهگیری F۱۶  مریکایی، اقدام به شلیک موشک به سمت آن کردند که در پی انفجار موشک در مجاورت این هواگرد، جنگنده آمریکایی متجاوز دچار آسیب شده و خلبان آن ناچار به لغو مأموریت و فرود اضطراری در یکی از نزدیک‌ترین فرودگاه‌های منطقه شد. dnws.ir/003
events.title_en: Video: Damage to American F-16 fighter jet and cancellation of its mission by firing indigenous systems of the Army's air defence force. The Army's public relations announced: on Friday evening, indigenous systems of the Army's air defence force deployed in the southern part of the country, under the control of the country's integrated air defence network, succeeded in detecting and identifying an American F-16 fighter jet over the Persian Gulf. During this operation, after intercepting the American F-16, air defence systems fired a missile at it, and following the missile explosion in the vicinity of the aircraft, the American fighter jet was damaged and its pilot was forced to cancel the mission and make an emergency landing at one of the nearest airports in the region.
